meta.siteTitle: Al Rawi Smart Home | Smart Home Solutions in Oman & Saudi Arabia
meta.siteDescription: Al Rawi Smart Home designs and installs smart home systems in Muscat and Riyadh: control panels, lighting, security, audio, curtains and more.
meta.productsDescription: Smart home devices installed by Al Rawi: control panels, switches, sensors, locks, speakers, curtains and garage control.

hero.title: Your home, one touch ahead
hero.subtitle: Lighting, climate, security and sound, designed and installed as one connected system. Serving Oman and Saudi Arabia since 2021.

what.title: A house that runs itself, the way you like it
what.body: A smart home is a house equipped with technology that allows you to control and automate everyday functions. Lights, air conditioning, security cameras and door locks can be managed through a smartphone or voice commands. It saves time, improves comfort, increases safety and reduces energy consumption by using devices more efficiently.
